title: Pass 3 reduced sac model: squamous peripodial epithelium (PE) + lumenal hydrostatic pressure coupled to the columnar disc proper (DP) of the Drosophila third-instar wing imaginal disc
scope_note: Pass 3 remediation of the Pass 2 audit item 'extend the 2D sagittal bilayer solver to a full 3D FEM coupling the disc proper to the peripodial epithelium and lumenal pressure'. A full 3D FEM was NOT implemented. This file parameterises the closest honest reduced version: a quasi-1D (plane-strain sagittal) three-compartment sac in which (i) the DP apical surface comes from the Pass 2 bilayer solver, (ii) the PE is a tensioned squamous membrane in unilateral contact with the DP, (iii) the lumen is an incompressible fluid whose hydrostatic pressure p is set by a prescribed fluid volume (volume mode) or imposed directly (pressure mode), and (iv) p deflects the DP dome through a Laplace-law shell response. Every number below carries a provenance tag; values tagged 'assumption' have no direct wing-disc measurement and must be treated as model inputs, not data.

provenance_tags.literature: value taken from a cited paper (approximate, read from text/figures; could not be re-verified offline in Pass 3)
provenance_tags.derived: value computed from the SHA-256-pinned Pass 2 reference table wing_disc_dome_folding_reference.json
provenance_tags.assumption: order-of-magnitude modelling assumption with no direct Drosophila wing-disc measurement

h_PE_squamous_um.source: McClure & Schubiger (2005) Development 132:5033-5042 describe late-L3 PE cells as squamous (a few um thick) versus ~30 um columnar DP cells; 3 um is an approximate reading

h_margin_cuboidal_um.source: cuboidal margin cells joining PE to DP at the disc edge; sets the PE clamping offset above the DP edge

T_PE_mN_per_m.source: order-of-magnitude epithelial tissue tension; no PE-specific measurement exists

T_PE_ablation_mN_per_m.source: PE ablation control: membrane tension and lumen pressure set to zero

h_lumen_mean_ref_um.source: mean lumen height used to set the prescribed fluid volume V_target(t) = h_lumen_mean * L(t) per unit dorsoventral width

h_lumen_min_contact_um.source: minimum PE-DP gap enforced as a unilateral contact bound

p_lumen_default_Pa.source: default imposed pressure in pressure mode; below the ~100-300 Pa measured in the zebrafish otic vesicle (Mosaliganti et al. 2019 eLife 8:e39596), no wing-disc measurement exists

disc_proper_shell_response.law: Delta_z(s) = -(p / (16 * T_DP)) * [L_pouch^2 * w_dome(s) + w_fold^2 * w_fold_shape(s)]  (shallow-cap Laplace response of a tensioned shell to a transverse pressure; chord L_pouch = (1 - s_HP) * L(t))
disc_proper_shell_response.T_DP_law: T_DP = mu_BM * h_BM * (gamma_pouch^2 - gamma_pouch^-4) + T_cell  (neo-Hookean membrane tension of the equibiaxially stretched basal Collagen IV lamina plus a cortical floor)

T_cell_floor_mN_per_m.source: cortical/junctional tension floor so the shell response stays finite at 64 h AEL when gamma_pouch = 1

fold_position_shift_norm.source: Tozluoglu et al. (2019) Dev. Cell: fold positions are set by planar differential growth within the disc proper; PE/lumen coupling is predicted not to move them

lumen_pressure_at_half_dome_Pa.source: model prediction only; no published wing-disc lumen pressure

residual_remediation: Quasi-1D plane-strain sac only: no dorsoventral curvature, no 3D finite-element mesh, PE modelled as a membrane without growth or its own fold mechanics, lumen fluid treated as incompressible with an assumed mean height. Carry 'full 3D FEM of DP + PE + lumen' forward as a Pass 4 item.
